model: SciPy 1.11.4 make_smoothing_spline; cubic natural C2; unit observation weights; no frequency or Hall-step factors
lambda_rule: 1 / (median_native_dt * (2*pi*cutoff_scale_hz)^4); scale is continuum half-amplitude proxy, NOT calibrated discrete bandwidth
scale_reason: 100Hz observations, 3-5Hz wing fundamental and 9-15Hz third harmonic: bracket sub-third, near-third and above-third scales without assuming constant speed
phase_gauge: first valid Hall-indexed phase fixes one additive constant; all later Hall zero updates are diagnostics, not motion; absolute zero is uncalibrated
sparse_holdout: native row index modulo 5 equals 2; first/last 2 samples retained
selection: one common scale for A/B: minimize equal-segment sparse held-out count RMSE; within 2 percent of minimum choose stronger smoothing (smaller scale); never consult IMU metrics
block_rule: separate fit omits all points within +/-30ms of centers; selection frozen before block scores; no retuning
frequency_baseline: linear interpolation of count observations; PX4 frequency is same-source alpha=0.2 filter for comparison only
timestamp_scenario_note: 50us is an explicit hypothetical bound, not measured timestamp accuracy; no calibrated confidence intervals
cycle_comparison: Reuse saved Stage02.2 cycle edges, memberships and both whole-cycle splits exactly; H3 fixed + time trend, equal-cycle weighting, no model tuning; phase may use full encoder context but held IMU never fitted
synthetic: variable 4Hz mean speed with 4/12Hz phase modulation, rounded counts, native-like time jitter, injected +/-12deg Hall reference steps; analytic derivative truth and no step in encoder
validation: independent centered differences and composite midpoint integration; C2 knot limits; exact quadratic velocity extrema for monotonicity; compare native increments and interval averaged fitted velocity, not only point frequencies
scope: mechanical periodic coordinate only; no true wing-joint-angle claim, no 6DoF optimization, no official labels
